## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book suitable for young readers?**
Yes, the copy is designed to make complex mythological events engaging and easy to follow, perfect for children who enjoy epic stories.

**What makes the Trojan Horse story so important in mythology?**
The Trojan War and the tale of the Trojan Horse are cornerstones of Greek literature, symbolizing cunning strategy, fate, and the ultimate end of conflict after many years of struggle between civilizations.

**Does this volume cover other mythological figures?**
While focusing on the conclusion of the Trojan War, Volume 2 offers a comprehensive look at the legendary events surrounding Odysseus and the Greek heroes involved in the battle.
